title: Pulley Mechanical Advantage
description: Interactive simulation demonstrating mechanical advantage in pulley systems. Shows how multiple pulleys reduce the force needed to lift loads while increasing the rope distance pulled.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: simple machines
pulleys
physics
mechanical advantage
learningObjectives: Understand the key concepts of pulley mechanical advantage
Explore pulley mechanical advantage through interactive visualization
Apply knowledge of pulley mechanical advantage to solve problems
Experiment with parameters to observe their effects on pulley mechanical advantage
